# labels

```go
import "katenary.io/internal/generator/labels"
```

Package labels provides functionality to parse and manipulate labels.

## Constants

<a name="KatenaryAnnotationPrefix"></a>KatenaryAnnotationPrefix is the stable prefix used for annotations added to the generated Kubernetes objects. Annotations are internal metadata, not user configuration, so they are not versioned.

```go
const KatenaryAnnotationPrefix = "katenary.io"
```

<a name="KatenaryLabelPrefix"></a>KatenaryLabelPrefix is the prefix used by labels read from compose files and katenary files. It is versioned so that a configuration written for an older Katenary version is never silently reinterpreted.

```go
const KatenaryLabelPrefix = "katenary.v4"
```

## Variables

<a name="LegacyLabelPrefixes"></a>LegacyLabelPrefixes lists the label prefixes used by previous versions.

```go
var LegacyLabelPrefixes = []string{
    "katenary.io/",
    "katenary.v1/",
    "katenary.v2/",
    "katenary.v3/",
}
```

## func [LegacyLabelsError](<https://repo.katenary.io/Katenary/katenary/blob/feature/security-network-policies/internal/generator/labels/legacy.go#L15>)

```go
func LegacyLabelsError(projectName string, badLabels []string) error
```

LegacyLabelsError returns the blocking error shown when a project still uses labels from a previous Katenary version. badLabels is a list of human readable lines such as "\- web: katenary.v3/ports \-\> katenary.v4/ports".

<a name="LegacyLabelSuggestion"></a>
### func [LegacyLabelSuggestion](<https://repo.katenary.io/Katenary/katenary/blob/feature/security-network-policies/internal/generator/labels/katenaryLabels.go#L102>)

```go
func LegacyLabelSuggestion(legacy string) Label
```

LegacyLabelSuggestion returns the v4 label that should replace a legacy one. Only the prefix is rewritten: some labels were renamed between v1/v2 and v3, the migration guide lists the matching names.
